out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: There was no hot water provided at the bar handwashing sink. The hot water supply had been turned off.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. The PIC turned the hot water supply back on during the inspection to correct.

out_items.name: Proper hot holding temperatures

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: a container of brown gravy on the hot rail was 109º.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. The gravy was reheated to 165º to correct.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: beef and chicken saltena mixtures were not being held cold in the walk-in. The beef was 109º and the chicken was 135º.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. The food employee placed the mixture into shallow pans in the freezer to cool.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Separation of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. A bottle of Lime Away cleaner was stored over clean equipment in the warewashing area.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items by separating the poisonous and toxic materials by spacing or partitioning. The PIC moved the cleaner during the inspection to correct.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Cooling in Equipment
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: beef and chicken saltena mixtures were not being cooled properly. The mixtures were prepared at 9:45 this morning and were placed in the walk-in in large covered containers.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. The EHS educated the PIC on how to properly cool these foods.

out_items.name: Approved thawing methods used

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: Frozen vacuum-packaged salmon was not being thawed properly.
violations.corrective_action: To properly thaw vacuum-packages salmon, but the bags open prior to thawing. The PIC cut the bags open during the inspection to correct.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Handled Utensils Storage
violations.observation: Soup spoons were not stored properly and so that employees would not touch the food contact surfaces.
violations.corrective_action: Knives, forks, and spoons that are not prewrapped shall be presented so that only the handles are touched by employees and consumers if consumer self- service is provided. Store the spoons arranged with all handles in the same orientation. Correct as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed 6 months.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: foods in the True refrigerator at the wait station area were not being held cold enough. The ambient temperature of the unit was 46º.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. Please have the unit adjusted or serviced and let your EHS know when it is working properly.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: observed plywood being used to line shelving in the walk-in and the kitchen. The wood is not sealed or painted to make it non-absorbent and easily cleanable.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. Remove the plywood in the walk-in and kitchen or paint it to make is non-absorbent and easily cleanable. Correct as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed 6 months.

out_items.name: Non-food contact surfaces clean

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: there was a significant accumulation of dried food debris on the inside of the walk-in refrigerator door handle.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. Clean the walk-in refrigerator door handle to remove the food debris. Pay particular attention to the surfaces where employees touch the handle pull the door open. Correct as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection, not to exceed 6 months.

out_items.name: Certified Food Protection Manager

violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present at the beginning of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment. The CFM arrived about 15 minutes after the inspection started.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. A container of onions were stored on the floor and the storage area.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. The PIC corrected this during the inspection. CDI.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: the handles for the ice scoops were stored in the ice at the bar area.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. The PIC corrected during his inspection. CDI.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Cutting Board, When to Resurface or Discard
violations.observation: The cutting board(s) along the prep line are heavily scratched and scored and stained. The food contact surface is no longer easily cleaned and sanitized due to condition.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces such as cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. Replace the cutting boards along the prep tables as soon as possible, or before the next routine inspection.

out_items.name: Non-food contact surfaces clean

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: there was a significant amount of dried food built up on the inside of all the refrigerator door handles.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. Clean all the refrigerator door handles as soon as possible. These should be cleaned on a regular basis, such as daily.

out_items.name: Plumbing installed, proper backflow devices

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connections under the main handsink in the kitchen are leaking. The drain piping was damaged last night. The hot and cold water were both turned off at the bar hand sink.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. Repair the drain piping on the hands sink as soon as possible. The pic had already contacted a plumber to fix. The manager turned on the water at the bar hand sink during the inspection.

out_items.name: Hands clean and properly washed

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. Observed employee wash hands with gloves on instead of washing hands then changing gloves.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. Education provided and hands properly wash + gloves changed.

out_items.name: No bare hand contact with ready-to-eat food, or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed

violations.title: No Bare Hand Contact with RTE Foods
violations.observation: Food employee(s) was observed handling the following ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands: observed employee pick up cooked egg with bare hands and plate it on ready to eat meat.
violations.corrective_action: Except when washing fruits and vegetables, food employees may not contact ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands. Employees shall be using suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, or clean disposable gloves to handle all ready-to-eat foods. Proper handling of food and effective handwashing procedures will help prevent foodborne illness. Education provided and item discarded.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the chlorine-based sanitizing solution was observed to be at a concentration less than what is required for effective sanitization of food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils. Observed the sanitizing solution in the 3-vat sink with a concentration of 0 ppm total chlorine.
violations.corrective_action: A chlorine-based sanitizing solution shall have a minimum concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine when tested using the appropriate test kit. Employee raised concentration to 200 ppm.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: various pots and pans.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. Chlorine concentration in 3-vat sink was fixed and items were sanitized.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the low temperature, chemical sanitizing warewashing machine was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 50 ppm chlorine solution.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the three-compartment sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food-contact surfaces using a sanitizing solution at the proper concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine. Please send repair invoice within 3 days.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: cooked beans from 2 days ago.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. Item date marked.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees. EHS observed no handwashing signage at the handsink in the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. OWNERSHIP UNDERSTANDS TO POST A HANDWASHING SIGN AT THE HANDSINK IN THE KITCHEN. PLEASE MAKE THIS CORRECTION BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: cases of raw shelled eggs were observed being stored above sauces and/or beverages in the walk in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EHS INSTRUCTED OWNERSHIP ABOUT THE PROPER STORAGE ORDER. RAW SHELLED EGGS, RAW SEAFOOD, RAW MEAT, AND RAW CHICKEN SHOULD NOT BE STORED ABOVE ANY READY-TO-EAT FOOD PRODUCTS. MANAGEMENT TO REORGANIZE THE WALK-IN UNIT AFTER THE LUNCH RUSH.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: Observed no symbol next to eggs and flank steak menu items. Owner indicated that these food items can be requested undercooked by the consumer.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. EHS DISCUSSED THE MENU WITH THE OWNER. OWNER IS TO SEND AN UPDATED DRAFT OF THE NEW MENU TO THE EHS BY NEXT WEEK FOR REVIEW. PLEASE PUT THE SYMBOL NEXT TO EGGS AND FLANK STEAK AND REMOVE THE SYMBOL FROM ANY SEAFOOD ITEMS. SEND THE DRAFT BY FRIDAY, 2/28/2025.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: EHS observed non-food grade oil being stored on a shelf used for storing food prep items.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. PIC MOVED THE NON-FOOD GRADE OIL TO THE CHEMICAL STORAGE AREA.

violations.title: Storage-Personal Care Items
violations.observation: Observed a bottle of Vicks stored on a shelf containing spices and other dried goods.
violations.corrective_action: All employees' personal care items shall be stored in a way that prevents the contamination of food and food contact surfaces through improper labeling or storage. PIC MOVED THE BOTTLE OF VICKS.

out_items.name: Food properly labeled, original container

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: Observed working containers of foods in squeeze bottles, cups, bins, etc not labeled.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF TO LABEL ALL WORKING CONTAINERS OF FOODS SUCH AS OIL, WATER, SALT, DRY SEASONINGS, PEPPER, ETC. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. EHS observed several food items on the floor of the walk in refrigerator, walk in freezer, and kitchen: 1) various types of meat; 2) boxes of frozen seafood; 3) 5 gallon buckets of sauces, 4) fryer oil (corrected during inspection).
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EHS INSTRUCTED OWNERSHIP TO PURCHASE NSF APPROVED SHELVING OR DUNNAGE RACKS TO KEEP FOOD OFF THE FLOOR. PLEASE MAKE THIS CORRECTION BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION. VICTOR'S GRILL 2 (Inspection Date: 02/20/2025) Page 2 of 4

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: EHS observed knives being stored in between the prep table and the wall. EHS observed plastic quart containers to scoop sugar and rice.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC REMOVED THE KNIVES FROM THE WALL. AN ADDITIONAL MAGNETIC STRIP CAN BE PLACED IN THAT AREA TO STORE KNIVES OR STORE KNIVES ON THE EXISTING MAGNETIC STRIP . THE AREA IN BETWEEN THE WALL AND THE TABLE CANNOT BE CLEANED AND SANITIZED. EHS INSTRUCTED THE STAFF MEMBER TO REMOVE THE QUART PLASTIC CUPS AND PROVIDE FOOD SCOOPS FOR THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers of Garlic Salt and Old Bay were being used to store other dried spices.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC AND OWNERSHIP ABOUT NOT REUSING MANUFACTURER CONTAINERS. PLEASE USE NSF APPROVED OR FOOD GRADE CONTAINERS FOR STORAGE.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Cutting Board, When to Resurface or Discard
violations.observation: The cutting board(s) along the prep line are heavily scratched and scored. The food contact surface is no longer easily cleaned and sanitized due to condition.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces such as cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. EHS DISCUSSED WITH OWNERSHIP TO REPLACE CUTTING BOARDS. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: EHS observed broken gaskets on the 3DR prep top. EHS also observed non-functioning light bulbs under the exhaust hood.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. OWNERSHIP IS MADE AWARE OF THE CONDITION OF THE GASKETS AND WILL REPLACE THEM. OWNERSHIP IS MADE AWARE OF THE BROKEN LIGHTS. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Smooth, Easily Cleanable
violations.observation: EHS observed trash bags and plastic grocery bags being used to store meat in the walk in refrigerator and walk in freezer.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be finished to have a smooth, easily cleanable surface. EHS DISCUSSED WITH OWNERSHIP TO USE NSF APPROVED STORAGE CONTAINERS AS THEY ARE CLEANABLE AND DURABLE. ENSURE CORRECTION BEFORE THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Non-food contact surfaces clean

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: EHS observed the doors of the 3DR prep top, inside the 3DR prep top, stove knobs, underneath shelving and prep top lids with a build up of food debris.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. EHS INSTRUCTED OWNERSHIP TO CLEAN MORE FREQUENTLY. PLEASE HAVE THIS CORRECTED BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION. VICTOR'S GRILL 2 (Inspection Date: 02/20/2025) Page 3 of 4

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: EHS observed the kitchen doors and walls behind the cook line and the prep line with a build up of food debris.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. EHS DISCUSSED WITH OWNERSHIP TO CLEAN MORE FREQUENTLY. PLEASE MAKE THIS CORRECTION BY THE NEXT ROUTIN INSPECTION.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: EHS observed ceiling panels with gaps and holes.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. EHS DISCUSSED WITH OWNERSHIP TO FILL GAPS TO PREVENT PESTS FROM ENTERING. EHS ALSO DISCUSSED TO REPLACE CEILING PANELS. ENSURE CEILING PANELS ARE SEALED BEFORE THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.
